##### Project general facts

Calisi by Zoya is a boutique residential development, designed as a limited collection of studios and two-bedroom residences that emphasise balance, openness and effortless living. The architecture follows a modern minimalist approach, where clean lines and thoughtful proportions create a calm and refined visual identity with a sense of privacy and spatial clarity.

The development offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to support both activity and relaxation. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped gym, separate swimming pools for adults and children, a dedicated kids' play area and a barbecue zone, while landscaped open spaces, outdoor seating areas and yoga and relaxation zones create a peaceful environment that balances movement with tranquillity.

Interiors are crafted with a focus on harmony, functionality and refined aesthetics. All residences are delivered fully furnished and designed to maximise natural light and efficient use of space, while a neutral material palette with carefully selected finishes and textures enhances the sense of calm, creating a living environment that feels complete, cohesive and effortlessly sophisticated.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a strategically planned district in the southern part of Dubai, conceived as a major hub for economic, commercial and logistics activity. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, one of the world's largest airports by cargo volume, makes the district a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

Dubai South is home to the Expo City Dubai legacy district, which offers residential communities, educational institutions and recreational facilities alongside world-class event infrastructure. Green initiatives, eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings underline the district's commitment to sustainable living.

Dubai South is a thriving business and residential hub that attracts both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for end users and investors alike, supported by the ongoing economic diversification of Dubai.
